digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow and CI routing
propositions: Documentation-only changes unnecessarily consume the full OS/Python build matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, identity, eval, and golden-path jobs when a reduced docs-only lane with all documentation gates would suffice.

Path classification and the allowlist must execute only from trusted origin/main with the patchset diff as untrusted data; classifier failure or uncertainty must select the full route and block Verified.
The shared documentation gates must be extracted once into a composite action invoked by both full and docs-only routes without adding an extra runner job or duplicating gate commands.

Docs-only Verify must skip OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs while retaining all documentation validation (ADR, index, cross-reference, drift, quickstart, reference gates).

Structural workflow and gate consumers (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, and seven others) must migrate to follow extracted gates without losing assertions or weakening invariants.

Post-merge production validation must prove a genuine docs-only change selects the focused route with 80%+ wall-clock and runner-minute savings, and a genuine non-doc change completes the full test suite.
